units.source_text: 红梅右大臣的邸宅就在玉鬘夫人邸宅的东边。

en.t: The residence of the Right Minister Kobai stood just east of Lady Tamakazura's mansion.

units.source_text: 右大臣升官后大排飨宴，无数王孙公子都来庆贺。

en.t: After the Right Minister was promoted, he held a grand banquet, and countless princes and noblemen came to offer their congratulations.

units.source_text: 红梅右大臣想起正月间宫中赛射后夕雾左大臣在六条院举行“还飨”时及角力后举行飨宴时，匂兵部卿亲王均在场，便遣使去招请他，以为今日增光。

en.t: Remembering that Prince Niou, the Minister of War, had been present at the return banquets held by Left Minister Yugiri at Rokujo-in after the New Year archery contest at court and after the wrestling matches, the Right Minister Kobai sent a messenger to invite him, hoping his presence would add luster to the day.
But Prince Niou, the Minister of War, did not come.

units.source_text: 红梅右大臣一心一意打算把悉心抚育成长的女儿嫁给匂亲王，但匂亲王不知何故一向不放在心上。

en.t: The Right Minister Kobai was wholly intent on marrying the daughter he had raised with such care to Prince Niou, but for some reason the prince never took the matter to heart.

units.source_text: 源中纳言薰君年事渐长，品貌越发端正，事事不落人后。

en.t: Lord Kaoru, the Minamoto Middle Counselor, was growing older, his looks and bearing becoming ever more refined, and in everything he yielded to no one.

units.source_text: 于是红梅右大臣和真木柱夫人又看中了他，想选他为女婿。

en.t: So the Right Minister Kobai and Lady Makibashira set their sights on him as well and wished to choose him as their son-in-law.

units.source_text: 玉鬘夫人的邸宅就在邻近，玉鬘夫人听见红梅右大臣家车马盈门，仆从如云，

en.t: Lady Tamakazura's residence was nearby, and when she heard that carriages and horses thronged the Right Minister Kobai's gate and attendants gathered like clouds,

units.source_text: 开路喝道之声不绝于耳，便想起昔年髭黑大臣在日盛况，不胜落寞之感。

en.t: with the cries of outriders clearing the way constantly reaching her ears, she remembered the splendor of the days when Minister Higekuro was alive and was overcome with loneliness.

units.source_text: 她说：“萤兵部卿亲王逝世不久，这红梅大臣就和真木柱私通，世人都非难他们，指为过分轻率。

en.t: She said, "Not long after Prince Hotaru, the Minister of War, passed away, this Minister Kobai became involved with Makibashira, and everyone criticized them, calling it far too rash.

units.source_text: 岂知后来爱情一直不衰，这一对夫妻倒也像模像样。

en.t: Who could have known that their affection would never fade, and that as husband and wife they would turn out quite respectable?
One truly never knows how things in this world will turn out!
What am I supposed to do?"
